# Glide

> Vloer and Ploeg share a repository and documentation. Vloer supports standalone work; Ploeg owns authority for explicitly admitted work.

## Current reading path

- [Start here](docs/index.md): application boundaries and reading paths.
- [Product model](docs/domain/model.yaml): shared language, intentions and open choices.
- [System explanation](docs/landscape/index.md): responsibilities and current limits.
- [Vloer architecture](apps/vloer/docs/architecture.md): interactive session implementation.
- [Ploeg architecture](apps/ploeg/docs/architecture.md): managed execution implementation.
- [Vloer contracts](apps/vloer/docs/contracts/api.md): workbench HTTP interface.
- [Ploeg contracts](apps/ploeg/docs/contracts/README.md): producing schemas and worker control.
- [Managed workflow](docs/workflows/managed-execution.md): integration and recovery.
- [First cutover](docs/operations/first-cutover.md): preparation gates, release preview, artifact verification, live pilot and rollback.
- [Documentation policy](docs/documentation.md): sources, generation and review.
